_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 97% of 12h windows seeing <2pt moves and no confirmed breaker (ETF inflows resuming or VIX cracking below 15), the statistically honest call is HOLD inside the Anxiety coil until evidence forces a directional leg.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing coil statistics and trapped longs; narrative implies a patient accumulation stance leaning toward an eventual UP reversal based on the Aug 2024 analog, creating a split between 'wait for the coil to break' and 'prepare for the bottom to form'
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows turn positive (>20) and BTC funding cools below 0.003% while price holds $63k — this would shift toward Disbelief and justify a LONG signal
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC breaks below $60k with VIX spiking above 22 (forces Panic, justifies REDUCE/SHORT) OR ETF flows surge above 40 with DXY dropping below 98 (pushes to Disbelief, justifies LONG)
